purpose: Teach: タックル/浪人/飛鳥/ピカソ/ボンド/リンカーン/フットサル/ヤクルト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラグビーでタックルの練習をされてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been practicing rugby tackles, apparently.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle curiosity in the voice. Sharing something she's noticed about his father. Soft, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが浪人時代のお話して下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about when he was a ronin—studying for exams.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Eyes wide with the importance of what he's learned. Quick but not rushed. The proud tone of someone sharing something he understood.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが飛鳥時代の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been reading you picture books about the Asuka period, I hear.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. A small smile underneath the words. Noticing and acknowledging the sweetness of it. Slow, warm pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとピカソの展覧会に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to see a Picasso exhibition!
lines.style: Excited but contained—the kind of joy a six-year-old holds when sharing something genuinely special. Quick delivery on the name. Small gasp of delight at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがボンドの映画を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been watching Bond films, it seems.
lines.style: Amused observation. A hint of warmth at the ordinariness of it. Unhurried delivery. The tone of someone sharing a small, affectionate detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとリンカーンの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, me and Dad read a picture book about Lincoln!
lines.style: Genuine excitement with the unselfconscious enthusiasm of a young child. Clear pronunciation of 'Lincoln.' Slight breathlessness—he wants her to understand why this matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフットサルチームに入られたのよ
lines.en: Sho, apparently your dad's joined a futsal team.
lines.style: Soft, slightly amused observation. A warmth underneath—noting his father's energy and willingness to try new things. Even, reflective pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとヤクルトの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the Yakult game with Dad!
lines.style: Pure, unselfconscious joy. The kind of simple happiness that comes from being with someone you love doing something ordinary. Bright, quick delivery. Closing with genuine satisfaction.
